title: Include Speaker Notes?
description: Speaker notes (Presenter Mode) adds speaking notes beside each slide for reference during presentations. Press S to open Presenter View.

options.label: Yes — Include Speaker Notes (Presenter Mode)
options.description: Each slide includes speaker notes. Ideal for formal talks and online presentations. Uses the presenter-mode-reveal template.

options.label: No — Plain Slides Only
options.description: Slides only, no speaker notes. Best for quick sharing and self-reading content.
